TRANSMUTER-TRANSMUTER.title: The Transmuter
TRANSMUTER-TRANSMUTER.description:
A hermetic alchemist pursuing the Magnum Opus.
Imbues enemies with [gold]Salt[/gold], [gold]Sulfur[/gold], and [gold]Mercury[/gold] to trigger volatile [gold]Reactions[/gold].
TRANSMUTER-TRANSMUTER.goldMonologue: Every coin is merely lead that learned ambition.
TRANSMUTER-TRANSMUTER.eventDeathPreventi: The Great Work is not yet complete.
TRANSMUTER-TRANSMUTER.aromaPrinciple: Solve et Coagula — dissolve the impure, and coagulate the divine.
TRANSMUTER-TRANSMUTER.cardsModifierDescr: Transmuter cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
